findings.title: Broken Supabase Key Reference in mediaUpload.jsx and SupabaseUploader.jsx
findings.description: The design references VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY but .env contains VITE_SUPABASE_KEY. Both mediaUpload.jsx (line 3) and SupabaseUploader.jsx (line 7) attempt to use the non-existent VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY environment variable, making these utilities non-functional.
findings.fix: Choose one: (A) Rename VITE_SUPABASE_KEY to VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY in .env (recommended), or (B) Update both utility files to use VITE_SUPABASE_KEY. Recommended: Option A for semantic clarity and Supabase standard naming.

findings.title: Missing Specification: Technologies String-to-Array Transformation in ProjectFormModal
findings.description: The design states forms pass technologies as comma-separated strings to the API, but does not specify where the string-to-array transformation occurs for the new ProjectFormModal component. The backend expects technologies as an array [String]. Without explicit transformation, form submissions will fail schema validation.
findings.location: Design §2 (Submission Logic), ProjectFormModal.jsx (to be created), projectController.js backend
findings.fix: Add explicit specification to ProjectFormModal.jsx submission logic: convert technologies from comma-separated string to array before passing to API, matching the pattern in ProjectsPage.jsx lines 124-126. Example: technologies.split(',').map(item => item.trim()).filter(Boolean)

findings.title: Missing Integration Details: ProjectDetailsModal Click Handlers Not Specified
findings.description: The design describes ProjectDetailsModal component and its integration with projectPage.jsx and projects.jsx, but does not specify how click events are wired. No detail provided for: (1) parent state management (selectedProject state), (2) click handler flow (does ProjectCard emit click? does parent wrap it?), (3) modal prop passing.
findings.fix: Add detailed integration subsection specifying: (1) Parent component adds useState for selectedProject, (2) ProjectCard accepts onSelectProject prop and calls it on click, (3) ProjectDetailsModal rendered conditionally with isOpen={selectedProject !== null}, (4) Example: <ProjectCard ... onSelectProject={setSelectedProject} /> and <ProjectDetailsModal isOpen={selectedProject !== null} project={selectedProject} onClose={() => setSelectedProject(null)} />

findings.title: Unverified Assumption: Public /api/projects Endpoint Filtering By Status
findings.description: The design notes 'if filtering needed (e.g., status: "Completed"), verify in projectController' but does not verify or resolve. Backend projectController.getProjects() returns all projects without filtering. Users will see projects marked 'In Progress' or other draft statuses alongside completed projects.
findings.fix: Verify and document business rule: (A) Filter to status='Completed' only (stricter, hides drafts), (B) Filter to status='Completed' OR status='Active' (mixed), or (C) Show all (current). Recommendation: Option A. Update backend: const projects = await Project.find({ status: 'Completed' }).sort({ createdAt: -1 }). Document decision in design.

findings.title: Missing Dependency and Version Pinning: Framer Motion
findings.description: The design mandates Framer Motion for animations but package.json does not include it. Design §6 says 'Add framer-motion to package.json' but provides no pinned version (only conditional example '...or specific version, e.g., ^10.16.0'). Without a pinned version, builds may pick different major versions.
findings.fix: Add to package.json dependencies: "framer-motion": "^10.16.0" (pinned to major version 10). Update design to specify exact version: 'Framer Motion version 10.16.0 or later (^10.16.0)'. Run npm install after updating.
